Summarize generic treatment results

Source: R/summarize_treatment_results.R
summarize_treatment_results.Rd

Aggregate raw outputs from simulate_treatment() by treatment, computing counts plus means and SDs for numeric response fields. This is useful for structured outputs such as readability, sentiment, or any other custom numeric scores returned by the model.

Usage

summarize_treatment_results(
  x,
  by_identity = FALSE,
  by_turn = TRUE,
  fields = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A data frame or list-like object containing raw rows as produced by simulate_treatment(). If a list is supplied, nested data frames are flattened before summarising.

by_identity

Logical. If TRUE, summaries are computed separately by identity when an identity column is present.

by_turn

Logical. If TRUE (default), summaries are computed separately by turn using turn_type when available, otherwise turn_index.

fields

Optional character vector of numeric columns to summarize. Defaults to all numeric columns except common bookkeeping fields such as sim, turn_index, and treatment_index.

Value

A tibble summarizing the requested aggregation level. Numeric fields are returned as mean_* and sd_* columns, alongside a sim count. Model metadata attributes are copied to the result.

Examples

readability <- tibble::tibble(
  treatment = c("treatment_1", "treatment_1", "treatment_2"),
  sim = c(1, 2, 1),
  turn_type = "turn_1",
  readability_score = c(6, 8, 7),
  readability_confidence = c(4, 5, 4)
)

summarize_treatment_results(readability)
#> # A tibble: 2 × 8
#>   treatment   turn_type   sim mean_readability_score sd_readability_score
#>   <chr>       <chr>     <int>                  <dbl>                <dbl>
#> 1 treatment_1 turn_1        2                      7                 1.41
#> 2 treatment_2 turn_1        1                      7                NA   
#> # ℹ 3 more variables: mean_readability_confidence <dbl>,
#> #   sd_readability_confidence <dbl>, treatment_index <int>
